comments.text: Hafa Adai and good afternoon from Guahan! It's here that the great U.S. of A's day begins as well.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Håfa Adai right back, and thank you for watching from Guåhan itself. You're right — while the rest of the States is still on yesterday, the day has already started with you. Si Yu'os ma'åse' for stopping by.

comments.author: @MJSavea
comments.text: Hafa Adai! Im a chamorro from the island of Saipan in the Northern Mariana Islands. Its about 100+ miles north of Guam. I lived on Guam for about 16 years but have relocated to Washington State. I would very much love to go back.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Håfa Adai! Sixteen years on Guam and roots in Saipan — that's a lot of the Marianas in one life. If the film missed something about home, we'd rather hear it from you than read it anywhere else.

comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: Would you actually live on Guam - thousands of miles from the US mainland but surroundede by this incredible Pacific beauty? YEs or NO?

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: That's a great question! Living thousands of miles from the US mainland, surrounded by such incredible Pacific beauty, definitely has its pros and cons. I'd have to weigh them carefully.
